part.text:
Added a live-reload dev server to the SSG:

- **`src/serve.ts`** — `startDevServer()` builds the site, serves `./dist` over HTTP, injects a WebSocket live-reload client script into every HTML response, watches `content/` and `templates/` with chokidar (debounced rebuild), and broadcasts `"reload"` to connected clients via a `ws` WebSocketServer mounted at `/__livereload`.
- **`src/cli.ts`** — new `serve` command with `--content`, `--output`, `--templates`, and `--port` (default 3000) options, wired to `startDevServer`.
- Added `chokidar@^3.6.0` and `ws@^8` (+ `@types/ws`) as dependencies — pinned chokidar to v3 since v5 requires Node ≥20.19 and this environment has 20.11.
- Tests: `src/serve.test.ts` (script injection, static serving, 404s, and an end-to-end file-change → rebuild → WebSocket reload test) and `src/cli-serve.test.ts` (CLI option parsing/wiring, with `startDevServer` mocked so no server is left listening after tests).
- Verified `build` command and existing tests are untouched/unbroken, and manually smoke-tested `ssg build` and `ssg serve` end-to-end (curl + live content edit triggered a rebuild).

TESTS: 39 passed, 0 failed
